scripts.lint: npm -w apps/web run lint && npm -w apps/api run lint
scripts.test: npm -w apps/web run test && npm -w apps/api run test
scripts.build: npm -w apps/web run build && npm -w apps/api run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --raw --names 'web,api' --prefix-colors 'blue,magenta' "npm -w apps/web run dev" "npm -w apps/api run dev"
